mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of building a new backyard deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a new backyard deck is influenced by several factors, including the deck's size, material choices, design complexity, and site preparation needs. For example, pressure-treated lumber is generally more budget-friendly, while composite or exotic hardwoods offer durability and require less maintenance, but come at a higher initial cost. Complex designs involving multiple levels, built-in features, or custom railings also increase expenses. Before we provide a detailed estimate, we assess the site to determine if any significant grading or foundation work is required, which can impact the overall project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deck size, material choice, design complexity, and site preparation are the main factors affecting the cost of a new backyard deck.
